The '''66th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] and [[television]] of 2008, was broadcast on January 11, 2009, from the [[Beverly Hilton Hotel]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]], United States on the [[NBC]] television network. The broadcast was watched by approximately 14.6 million viewers with a rating of 4.9/12. The ceremony returned after the previous year's ceremony was canceled due to the [[2007–08 Writers Guild of America strike|Writers Guild of America strike]]. The nominations were announced on December 12, 2008.
